description: Pinned external Da Vinci implementations used by the Cloud Health Office interoperability harness. Every entry MUST be reproducible: an image digest, a release tag plus commit SHA, or a commit SHA. Never a floating tag or unpinned branch. See docs/interop/davinci.md for the upgrade procedure.

targets.name: HL7-DaVinci/br-payer

pin.sourceCommitProvenance: org.opencontainers.image.revision label on the pinned image config

auth.note: The pinned image serves the FHIR endpoint unsecured. It is bound to the loopback interface on a dedicated bridge network and only ever receives synthetic data.

targets.igVersionProvenance: Observed from the pinned image's startup package installation (packages2.fhir.org downloads), not from upstream source at HEAD.
requiredEgress: https://packages2.fhir.org — Da Vinci IG packages are downloaded at container startup; the server fails to boot without it.
targets.startupNotes: HAPI FHIR JPA starter (8.8.0). Boot takes roughly 60-120s: JPA schema, IG package install, then the FHIR endpoint. Poll GET /fhir/metadata; do not sleep.

targets.name: inferno-framework/carin-for-blue-button-test-kit

pin.pinProvenance: git ls-remote --tags resolved refs/tags/v0.16.3 to this commit on 2026-10-23, and it was the latest release on that date.

auth.note: Inferno drives CHO as the system under test; CHO's SMART configuration is supplied as suite input, never by weakening CHO.

inferno.suitesProvenance: Read from the Inferno::TestSuite ids in the kit's own lib/ at the pinned tag, not from documentation.
inferno.runner: docker compose build && docker compose up (upstream run.sh) from a checkout at the pinned tag

implementationGuides.CARIN BB: 1.1.0 and 2.0.0, plus a 2.0.0 development snapshot of the non-financial branch

targets.igVersionProvenance: Read from package.json inside the IG packages the kit bundles at the pinned tag. The non-financial package (igs/carin4bb-200-dev-nonfinancial-fixed) self-identifies as hl7.fhir.us.carin-bb 2.0.0 dated 2023-04-24.
knownMismatches: CHO's non-financial ExplanationOfBenefit declares the CARIN BB 2.2.0 '-Basis' profiles (C4BB-ExplanationOfBenefit-Inpatient-Institutional-Basis and its siblings). The c4bb_v200devnonfinancial suite at this pin checks the earlier '-NonFinancial' canonicals from the April 2023 branch snapshot it bundles. The canonical URLs differ, so that suite cannot judge CHO's EOBs as they stand. The resolution is a later kit release regenerated against CARIN BB 2.2.0, never renaming CHO's profiles to match a superseded draft.
requiredEgress: https://github.com — the kit is fetched at the pinned tag during explicit setup
https://rubygems.org and Docker Hub — the kit image is built locally from upstream's Dockerfile
https://packages.fhir.org — the bundled hl7_validator_service loads IG packages
targets.startupNotes: No upstream-published image exists for this kit; it is built from a checkout at the pinned tag during explicit setup. Not started by any scenario yet. This is the kit that would judge Provider Access EOB conformance (gap-matrix G-14); neither the PDex nor the DTR kit covers CARIN BB.

targets.name: hl7/fhir-validator (validator_cli.jar)

auth.note: Runs as a local command over files on disk. It never calls a CHO service, and the goldens it reads are synthetic.

implementationGuides.note: The script passes no -ig flag of its own: each golden declares its profile in meta.profile and the validator resolves the publishing package from the FHIR package registry.

targets.igVersionProvenance: Resolved per instance by the validator from packages.fhir.org at run time, so the effective package version is recorded in the run log rather than pinned here.
requiredEgress: https://github.com — the jar is fetched at the pinned tag during explicit setup
https://packages.fhir.org and https://packages2.fhir.org — IG packages are resolved per instance
targets.startupNotes: Needs a JRE 11 or later; CI runners carry Java 21. Terminology checking is switched off with -tx n/a, so value-set bindings are NOT verified. scripts/interop/fhir-validate.sh records what that leaves unproven.

contentSources.name: HL7-DaVinci/CDS-Library
contentSources.purpose: CRD/DTR/PAS test content: PlanDefinition, Questionnaire, Library, CQL, ValueSet and prior-auth rule fixtures for future scenarios.
contentSources.license: No LICENSE file is present in the repository at the pinned commit. Treat as reference-only: fetch at the pin during explicit setup, never vendor into this repository, and resolve licensing with HL7 before copying any file.
contentSources.note: The pinned br-payer image already bundles the clinical content its own CRD/DTR/PAS rules need, so no scenario in this PR consumes CDS-Library. The pin exists so a later scenario can point at specific upstream PlanDefinitions/Questionnaires/CQL without copying them into CHO.
